title: Repository onboarding path
alt: Five onboarding commands scaffold configuration and agent files, record debt, prepare a devcontainer, and verify governance.
text: Onboarding commands, in order: 1. Scaffolding (praetorctl init), 2. Context Recompilation (praetorctl compile-context), 3. Brownfield Baselining (praetorctl baseline --record --allow-increase), 4. Devcontainer Setup (praetorctl devcontainer generate), 5. Audit Verification (praetorctl audit).
Boxes: Target repository (already carries AGENTS.md), Alternate entry (praetorctl adopt), Governed repository (praetorctl audit pass).
Target repository → 1. Scaffolding (start) → 2. Context Recompilation → 3. Brownfield Baselining → 4. Devcontainer Setup → 5. Audit Verification.
Alternate entry → 5. Audit Verification (skips 1-4) → Governed repository (verified).

Scenario 1, init: Write the configuration, then compile the vendor files from AGENTS.md. init reads AGENTS.md beside the manifest; without it, init writes no agent files. createInitialManifest and initBaselineAndLockfile write the manifest, the lockfile and a zero-debt baseline. initAgentContext runs the compile-context write: Git ignores .workingdir/evidence/, the text register is spliced into AGENTS.md, and the six vendor files and persona copies are compiled and linted.

Scenario 2, compile-context: Recompile the vendor files and persona copies; rerun after every AGENTS.md edit. compile-context runs the same write that init ran. writeAgentSurfaces copies every .agents/agents persona into each client persona directory, then the caveman lint runs.

Scenario 3, baseline: Snapshot legacy technical debt into baseline file. HISS scanner sweeps the codebase for existing infractions. Initial legacy debt is recorded with --allow-increase and --reason="<why>" to permit non-zero count.

Scenario 4, devcontainer: Prepare a portable devcontainer from reviewed Praetor sources. DevContainer configuration and reviewed source bundle companions are generated. The configuration, Dockerfile.praetor and up to eight source parts are written to .devcontainer/.

Scenario 5, audit: Verify configured governance contracts and debt ratchet. Audit checks manifest, lockfile, agent context, debt baseline, and DevContainer. Every executed gate passes with zero files modified; repository is verified and governed.
(Shortened to 2500 characters; docs/figures/onboarding-path.ts holds the full content.)
